source: one of pi's own session logs for this repo (2026-11-16, 3101 lines), cut just after its first `compaction` entry. Taken from the log file rather than over the relay because no paired room has ever compacted — the `test` room refused `/compact` ("Nothing to compact (session too small)") and wrote NO entry for the attempt. pi's log lines are the entries the extension forwards, so the slice is the wire content; pi's leading `session` line is dropped because the extension does not forward it.
scrub: Content → «length» (the compaction `summary` is 4093 chars of prior-conversation text and is replaced whole; `systemMessage`, `details`, `usage` likewise). Structure kept verbatim: ids, the parentId chain, ISO timestamps, `firstKeptEntryId`, `tokensBefore` (213920 — the number the caption renders), `fromHook`, keys everywhere. Verified: no absolute path, username or hostname survives.
description: The compaction plane, captured rather than authored. A `compaction` ENTRY (pi's shape: `summary`, `tokensBefore`, `firstKeptEntryId`, `fromHook`, `systemMessage`, `usage`, `details`) mid-chain, folded by the reference through the SAME funnel as the live wire — `SessionState+BirthEntry.swift:18` synthesizes a `compaction_end` rpc carrying the entry id, and the live plane's `compaction_end` comes from the extension remapping pi's `session_compact` EVENT (`extension/src/session/rpc_envelope.ts:338`), which is why folding on the event name matches nothing. Pins the marker row's identity: entry-born markers key on the entry id and insert before the live tail; live ones take a seq id and append. Also carries 351 entries of ordinary chain so the marker's neighbours stay in order. A SECOND compaction entry, captured from a native `/compact` (`fromHook: false`) rather than the pre-compact hook (`fromHook: true`): the shape is identical field-for-field — summary, firstKeptEntryId, tokensBefore, details{readFiles,modifiedFiles}, usage{…}, systemMessage — so a client that branches on fromHook, or that hides hook compactions, diverges. Across all 72 captured compaction entries in the local corpus every one carries all of those fields (66 hook, 6 native), and `tokensBefore` is always a real number (83,746–218,223); the `tokensBefore: 0` seen elsewhere is pi-durable's, not pi SDK's.
note: A failed `/compact` produces NO entry and NO frame — a client cannot learn about it from history. Only a successful compaction is visible. The native entry is RE-PARENTED onto this scenario's chain (its own ancestry is a different session). Its `firstKeptEntryId` (9a85b756) intentionally DANGLES: it names an entry that is not in this fixture, which is the normal case for a paged walk — and no client reads the field today (`firstKeptEntryId` appears in no app, extension or web-client source), so nothing resolves it. A future 'context starts here' divider must tolerate the id being outside the walked window.
